    else:

        middle = total_length // 2
        median = (median[middle - 1] / 2) + (median[middle] / 2)

    merged = sorted(nums1 + nums2)
    length = len(merged)
    middle = length // 2
    if length % 2 == 1:
        return merged[middle]
    else:
        return (merged[middle - 1] + merged[middle]) / 2
